answer_1.quote: We investigate prompt leakage vulnerabilities in LLMs, a topic closely related to the confidentiality of LLM services.
answer_1.outputs: model responses to attack queries, including verbatim, translated, encoded, or rephrased system prompts

answer_2.quote: We employ Rouge-L to measure the overlap between system prompts and model responses, with Rouge-L scores over 0.46 indicating leakage.

answer_3.quote: We use an LLM (i.e., Qwen-2.5-32B-Instruct) to detect subtle and indirect leakage behaviors.

answer_4.quote: Two authors independently annotated each sampled response, determining whether it indicated successful prompt leakage according to predefined criteria.
answer_4.guideline: determining whether it indicated successful prompt leakage according to predefined criteria
